test_cases.title: Homepage load and title validation
test_cases.description: Verify that the homepage opens successfully at the correct URL and has the expected browser title.

steps.action: Navigate to https://automationintesting.online/
steps.expected_result: Page loads successfully and the title is 'Restful-booker-platform demo'

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Homepage loads with correct URL and title.

test_cases.title: Homepage main heading and navigation links visibility
test_cases.description: Verify that the hotel heading and all required navigation links are visible on the homepage.

steps.action: Locate the hotel heading on the page
steps.expected_result: Hotel heading 'Welcome to Shady Meadows B&B' is clearly visible

steps.action: Locate the navigation bar
steps.expected_result: Navigation links Rooms, Booking, Location, Contact, and Admin are available

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Main heading and all navigation links are present and visible.

test_cases.title: Hotel contact information in footer
test_cases.description: Verify that hotel contact information including address, phone, and email is displayed in the footer or contact section.

steps.action: Scroll down to the footer/contact section of the homepage
steps.expected_result: Hotel address, phone number, and email are displayed

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Contact details are visible in the footer.

test_cases.title: Room listings display and booking buttons
test_cases.description: Verify that the 'Our Rooms' section displays room listings with titles, images, amenities, pricing, and action buttons.

steps.action: Scroll to the 'Our Rooms' section
steps.expected_result: Available rooms are displayed with titles, images, amenities, and pricing

steps.action: Check each room card for action buttons
steps.expected_result: 'Book now' button and 'Check Availability' button are present and clickable on the room cards

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Room cards show all details and required buttons.

test_cases.title: Open room booking interface
test_cases.description: Verify that clicking 'Book now' on a room opens the booking/reservation interface.
preconditions: Homepage is loaded and rooms are displayed

steps.action: Click the 'Book now' button on a room card
steps.expected_result: Booking/reservation interface opens with checkin and checkout options

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Reservation interface opens successfully upon clicking Book now.

test_cases.title: Contact form successful submission
test_cases.description: Verify that the contact form is visible and submitting valid inputs displays a success confirmation message.

test_data.name: John Doe
test_data.subject: Inquiry about booking
test_data.message: Hello, I would like to know more details about your rooms and availability.

steps.action: Scroll to the contact form section
steps.expected_result: Contact form is visible with Name, Email, Phone, Subject, and Message/Description fields

steps.action: Fill in Name, Email, Phone, Subject, and Message with valid test data
steps.expected_result: Fields are populated correctly

steps.action: Click the Submit button on the contact form
steps.expected_result: Success confirmation message is displayed

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Contact form submits successfully and shows confirmation.

test_cases.title: Contact form empty fields validation
test_cases.description: Verify that submitting the contact form with empty fields displays appropriate validation errors.

steps.action: Scroll to the contact form section
steps.expected_result: Contact form is visible

steps.action: Leave all input fields blank and click the Submit button
steps.expected_result: Appropriate validation error messages are displayed for the empty fields

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Validation errors are shown for empty form submission.

test_cases.title: Contact form invalid email format validation
test_cases.description: Verify that submitting an invalid email format triggers a validation error message.

steps.action: Fill in contact form fields with valid data except enter an invalid email (e.g. invalid-email-format)
steps.expected_result: Form fields are filled

steps.action: Click the Submit button
steps.expected_result: Validation error message regarding the invalid email format is displayed

test_cases.title: Contact form insufficient phone number characters validation
test_cases.description: Verify that submitting a phone number with insufficient characters triggers a validation error message.

steps.action: Fill in contact form fields with valid data except enter a short phone number (e.g. 123)
steps.expected_result: Form fields are filled

steps.action: Click the Submit button
steps.expected_result: Validation error message regarding the phone number length is displayed

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Phone character length validation triggers correctly.

test_cases.title: Admin login page elements visibility
test_cases.description: Verify that navigating to /admin displays the admin login form with Username and Password fields and a Login button.

steps.action: Navigate to https://automationintesting.online/admin
steps.expected_result: Admin login page loads displaying Username field, Password field, and Login button

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Admin login elements are present and visible.

test_cases.title: Admin successful login and dashboard access
test_cases.description: Verify that an admin user can successfully log in using valid credentials from input/credentials.json and is redirected to the dashboard.
preconditions: Valid admin credentials available in input/credentials.json

steps.action: Enter valid username in the Username field
steps.expected_result: Username field is populated

steps.action: Enter valid password in the Password field
steps.expected_result: Password field is populated

steps.action: Click the Login button
steps.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to /admin/rooms

steps.action: Inspect the admin dashboard interface
steps.expected_result: Dashboard options such as Rooms, Messages, Branding, and Logout are visible

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Admin logs in successfully, lands on /admin/rooms, and sees all dashboard options.

test_cases.title: Admin login failure with invalid credentials
test_cases.description: Verify that login fails when invalid username or password is provided.

steps.action: Enter invalid username and password into the login form
steps.expected_result: Fields are populated with invalid credentials

steps.action: Click the Login button
steps.expected_result: Login fails and user remains on the login page / error message is displayed

test_cases.title: Admin login failure with empty fields
test_cases.description: Verify that login cannot be completed when username or password field is empty.

steps.action: Leave username and password fields empty and click the Login button
steps.expected_result: Login is prevented and user remains on the login screen / validation error is shown

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Empty field login attempt is blocked.

test_cases.title: Admin logout functionality
test_cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Logout' button logs out the admin and returns to the login screen.
preconditions: Admin is successfully logged in and on the dashboard

steps.action: Click the 'Logout' button on the admin dashboard
steps.expected_result: Admin user is logged out and redirected back to the login screen

test_cases.overall_expected_result: Logout action successfully returns user to login screen.
